population: Exactly the ordinary R165 18,620 directional records and the sealed R167 candidates, subject unaries, calibrated scene geometry, pair terms and PCA. Same six-direction weighting. No new candidate generation on those target records and no FINAL access.
first_test: Audit UNKNOWN dominance over the fixed candidate banks, reproduce R167 decisions exactly, and separately remove the left or overlap term. On changes in the winning subject, decompose the score advantage over the best assignment constrained to the independent subject into subject, reference, signed direction and overlap differences.
one_new_reference_score: Use the R165 native token projections. Replace the raw role match with logsumexp of role logits minus logsumexp over the valid native sentence tokens. Keep the original R88 point-attention term. On the sealed bank recover this new unary algebraically by adding half the difference of the two native terms to the saved combined score, then recenter. Recompute the original overlap-discounted transfer for non-native boxes, keep the identical candidate admission, and independently verify the algebra on the source panel. Use the exact existing R88 token-ownership mask.
source_calibration: Use the existing own-platform training manifests and frozen source weights. Up to 72 distinct frames per source, selected without predicted performance, balanced by recording. Anchor identity requires an unambiguous singular nominal compatible with exactly one annotated object other than the subject and a visible annotated center. If the category is repeated in the frame, allow exactly one compatible annotation attached to the expression's other-object list after independent coordinate reconciliation. Assignment uses no direction conditions. Keep the unresolved cases in the source screening ledger. Compare against ordinary target frame and image/point content hashes without opening FINAL. Source labels are used only for calibrating the readout, with recording-held-out diagnostics where available and a stratified output-blind image spot check. No parameter update to the source checkpoints.
abstention: For each source fit one ridge logistic calibrator of the physical identity correctness of the old highest-ranked reference. Its two inputs are the uncentered native role log probability enrichment relative to the token-count baseline at that reference and the old physical rank margin. Clip inputs to the coordinate range observed in that source calibration. The same fitted score is used in all three abstention arms, independent of reference re-ranking and left/right sign. Use equal costs for a wrong binding and an unnecessary rejection. If source-calibrated probability is at or below 0.5, permit only UNKNOWN. Otherwise add the calibrated log odds to max-centered physical scores and compare against UNKNOWN at zero in exactly the same R167 assignment. Thus the strongest physical candidate competes at its calibrated odds before relation terms, and the relation cannot authorize a role with low unary evidence. This is a selective score, not a claimed normalized posterior over all physical candidates.
negative_control: In the scrambled arm rotate the new native reference correction among the same physical candidates by a deterministic nonidentity rotation. Keep its per-role multiset and the same geometry, old attention evidence and abstention scores. Record unpermutable roles as such.
counterfactual: Reuse all 2,526 single-predicate R167 interventions. Compare both directions of the same bank and reference reliability. Also replay the ten previously authored direction pairs with the same neutral text, same scene and matching seal. Require both actual subject identities and the same correct reference. Keep the original R167 blind-panel identity attempts.
oracle: After sealing all ordinary and controlled predictions, use only independent existing image-adjudicated physical references. For each verified edge with the correct reference in the common bank, restrict that role to the correct identity and select its highest original unary candidate, without selecting geometry by IoU. Single-edge fixed with predicted versus independently identified reference uses identical same-edge factors. Other edges are omitted in both arms of this diagnostic. Keep coverage omissions and report separately from deployable results. Never use orientation-conditioned proxy labels to define the oracle.
adoption: Compare with R158+PCA on all and the relation subsets, and with the calibrated old evidence and scrambled correction. Report active null, empty bank, identity unknown, effective relation changes, paired rescues and harms, both endpoints, source calibration quality, and the evidence-limiting denominators. A fallback to independent counts as reduced harm. It provides no incremental ground-truth benefit. No target-label optimization, training of the source model, or FINAL access.
